headline: Can you name the 4 basic tissue types?
body:
Epithelial: covers surfaces, lines cavities
Connective: binds and supports
Muscle: contracts to move
Nervous: carries signals
source: Source: OpenStax Anatomy & Physiology, 4.1 Types of Tissues

headline: Spinal nerves? Remember 8-12-5-5-1
stat_note: pairs: 8 C, 12 T, 5 L, 5 S, 1 Co
body:
8 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar,
5 sacral, 1 coccygeal.
Trick: 8 cervical nerves but 7 cervical vertebrae. C8 exits between C7 and T1.

headline: How many ribs do you have? 12 pairs
body:
Ribs 1 to 7: true ribs
Ribs 8 to 10: false ribs
Ribs 11 and 12: floating ribs
24 ribs in total, 12 on each side.
